run_slash_worker: run the slash_worker.py CLI with --session-key and --model arguments to process slash commands from stdin
run_hermes_command: run a HermesCLI slash command via _run() and capture its console output as a string
run_process_command: run cli.process_command() on a HermesCLI instance with redirected stdout/stderr
build_hermes_cli: build a HermesCLI instance with model, compact, resume, and verbose parameters for TUI sessions
test_slash_worker_protocol: test the slash_worker JSON-lines protocol that reads {id, command} from stdin and writes {id, ok, output|error} to stdout
